An Incident names a scene, >=2 exclusive outcomes (each one realization of a shared storylet with advantages and costs, all asserted true by that realization), a missed_window_event_id, a successor_transition_id and completes_scene (default true). Today the engine ignores incidents.

IMPLEMENT (no new persistent state: facts stay the sole mutable truth):
(a) A pure helper (in storygame/runtime/incidents.py or as a small engine method) resolved_incident_outcome(incident, facts) returning the IncidentOutcome whose advantage facts are ALL true (subject 'story', value 'true', the same way existing code reads a fact; find the idiom), else None. Because advantage sets are disjoint and realizations exclusive, at most one can match; if more than one ever matches return the first declared.
(b) Completion without the floor: in _apply_authored_transition, the min_turns floor is skipped for a transition when ALL hold: the package has an incident whose scene_id is the transition's source scene, completes_scene is true, transition.id == incident.successor_transition_id, and the incident has a resolved outcome. All other existing checks stay (eligible_transitions triggers, has_pending_break, transition_dependencies_available). Every transition not matching stays under the floor exactly as today.
(c) Missed window: the deadline backstop must not supply an unearned advantage in an incident scene. Read how handoff_after_turns drives _prepare_handoff / canonical_events (canonical_events.py:63, engine.py ~1125 and ~1329-1430). For a scene that declares an incident with NO resolved outcome, the forced handoff must not assert any outcome's advantage facts through the delivery path, and must not move the player to the successor scene. Implement the smallest change that holds this, leaving scenes without incidents byte-identical in behavior. If the cleanest way needs more than ~40 changed lines in engine.py, stop, implement only (a) and (b), and record in the notes exactly what (c) needs.
(d) Loader gap from step 2: an incidents.yaml whose top level is not a mapping, or whose 'incidents' value is not a list, must raise StoryPackageError (not AttributeError). Add the two tests to tests/test_incident_loader.py.

TESTS, in tests/test_incident_engine.py, real engine + a stub provider on the lighthouse-incident fixture (reuse the helpers in tests/test_pacing_handoff.py and neighbours for building an engine from a package and a stub provider; no network; whole file under 15 seconds). Edit the fixture only as needed so its successor transition t_1a_1b is triggered by the incident outcomes (use an any_of over the two outcomes' advantage facts, or add a fact both establish) instead of only brass_key_found, and keep tests/test_incident_loader.py passing. Cover: (1) resolving outcome copy_chart on turn 1 asserts chart_copied AND its own cost chart_page_torn, and not boat_route_known; the player enters 1B immediately although 1A min_turns is 2. (2) Same for learn_route, with NO chart_page_torn. (3) A transition in a scene without an incident still waits for min_turns (use the fixture or a second small fixture; show the floor still holds). (4) With no outcome chosen, play accepted no-op turns through tide_turns (turn 2) and past handoff_after_turns (3): no advantage fact is true, the scene is not 1B, and the missed-window fact tide_has_turned is true. (5) The two outcomes are exclusive: after one fires, the other's advantages never become true. (6) resolved_incident_outcome unit tests: none, A, B, both-true returns the first declared. Add one test for completes_scene false: build a modified copy of the fixture (tmp_path, shutil.copytree like test_incident_loader.py) and show the floor then holds.

HOW TO RUN: first confirm PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)" prints a path inside the cwd. Tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_incident_engine.py tests/test_incident_loader.py tests/test_incident_characterization.py. Then the FULL suite: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov -n auto . Ruff: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix <your files>, then -m ruff format <your files>. Do not run uv. The existing step 1 characterization test of the real package deadline backstop (turn 11) must still pass unchanged, since the real package has no incidents until step 6.
